result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.select_nodes_by_centrality()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Select top-K nodes by centrality measure. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L5804-L5891){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.select_nodes_by_centrality( measure="degree", k=10, include_ties=False, **kwargs, ) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Computes centrality scores for all nodes and selects the k highest-scoring nodes. Useful for identifying the most important or influential nodes by various centrality metrics. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [measure]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [["degree"]{.st}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Centrality measure to use: `"degree"`, `"in_degree"`, `"out_degree"`, `"pagerank"`, or "`betweenness"`. [k]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[10]{.dv}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Number of top nodes to select. [include_ties]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[False]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : If `True`, include all nodes tied with the k-th highest score. [**kwargs]{.doc-parameter-name} : Additional arguments for centrality algorithms (e.g., damping for Pagerank). ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Graph]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Self for method chaining. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Selects whichever nodes score highest on the chosen measure -- here, the `3` nodes with the greatest degree across a graph combining a star and a path: ::: {#df9373eb .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_star_graph(10) .add_path_graph(10) .select_nodes_by_centrality("degree", k=3) ) len(graph.get_selected_node_ids()) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` 3 ``` ::: ::: Extra keyword arguments are forwarded to the underlying centrality algorithm -- here `damping` is passed through to `pagerank()`: ::: {#6e3c9f14 .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} graph = ( ec.Graph(directed=True) .add_path_graph(20) .select_nodes_by_centrality("pagerank", k=5, damping=0.85) ) len(graph.get_selected_node_ids()) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` 5 ``` ::: :::
